cards.front: Recall a key point about Ecology and Ecosystems
cards.back: GPP = total photosynthesis; NPP = GPP - R (respiration); Efficiency = energy transferred/total available x100% (typically 10%); Pyramids: energy always upright; biomass can be inverted

cards.front: Recall a key point about Ecology and Ecosystems
cards.back: Carbon: photosynthesis, respiration, combustion, decomposition, ocean uptake; Nitrogen: fixation (lightning, bacteria), nitrification (ammonia->nitrite->nitrate), assimilation, denitrification

cards.front: Recall a key point about Ecology and Ecosystems
cards.back: Growth curves: lag, log, stationary, death; Carrying capacity K; r/K selection; Predator-prey: Lotka-Volterra cycles

cards.front: Recall a key point about Ecology and Ecosystems
cards.back: Succession: pioneer -> intermediate -> climax; each stage modifies environment for next; Deflected succession: human interference

cards.front: Recall a key point about Ecology and Ecosystems
cards.back: Climate change: greenhouse effect, CO₂, CH₄; Eutrophication: nitrates/phosphates -> algal bloom -> decomposition -> O₂ depletion -> dead zones
